changelog: **Tenant isolation engine fix (#1568):** the `orgContext` AsyncLocalStorage is now one per process (`globalThis`), like the Prisma client — with a per-module-instance store, a route could bind its org where the once-per-process middleware never looked, and `GET /api/interview-panels` listed every tenant's panels with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` on. **Tenant leak gate (#1568):** `e2e/isolation/leak-matrix.spec.ts` signs in as tenant B's admin, mentor and company user and calls 21 authenticated read surfaces (candidates, mentorship, companies, cohorts, analytics, activity, email log, webhooks, API keys, settings, evaluation templates, document requirements, invitations, interview panels, requisitions, users, tags) against a server with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION=true`, asserting the body carries none of tenant A's per-run markers — with a negative control (tenant A's same call must find every one of its own) and cross-tenant `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]`, `GET /api/mentorship/[id]` and `DELETE /api/status-changes/[id]` answering 404 with the row re-read unchanged. `e2e/isolation/uncovered-models.spec.ts` measures the middleware gap for the seven `orgId`-less child models (reachable only through their scoped parent). New `Playwright tenant isolation gate` job in `e2e.yml` runs the whole `isolation` project on every PR (no path filter; not yet a required check).
